title: Harness kill_tree signalled every process on Linux: pass the group id to kill after --
goal: crates/susi-harness/src/tools.rs kill_tree ran kill -TERM -<pid> to stop a timed-out worker command and its descendants. procps-ng 4.0.4 (Ubuntu 24.04) parses -<pid> as an option and takes its first digit as the target, so for a pid beginning with 1 the call became kill(-1, SIGTERM): every process the user owns was signalled (strace: kill -0 -19999 makes kill(-1, 0)). It took this cloud host down twice during the v0.21.68 tests gate. Pass the group id after -- as cancel_propagate.rs already does, and pin the argument list with a test (CEO direction 2026-11-15: cut the core release).
limitations: Verified on Linux x86_64 with procps-ng 4.0.4; the Windows branch (taskkill) is unchanged.
